ext_name.description: Extension name shown in Chrome Web Store and toolbar

ext_description.message: Capture full-page scrolling screenshots and custom regions at native High-DPI resolution. 100% private and local.

popup_capture_full.description: Button to capture the entire scrollable page

popup_capture_full_hint.message: Auto-scrolls and stitches at full screen resolution
popup_capture_full_hint.description: Hint under full page capture button

popup_capture_region.description: Button to drag-select a custom page region

popup_capture_region_hint.message: Drag any area, including tall scrollable sections

popup_status_selecting.message: Select an area on the page (press Esc to cancel)…
popup_status_selecting.description: Status while region selection overlay is active

popup_status_done.description: Status after capture completes and opens preview tab

popup_error_restricted_page.message: Browser system pages, extension stores, and built-in PDF viewers cannot be captured for security reasons.
popup_error_restricted_page.description: Friendly error when active tab is chrome://, Web Store, or PDF viewer

popup_error_generic.message: Capture failed. Please refresh the page and try again.

popup_format_label.description: Label above quick export format selector in popup

preview_empty_state.message: No active capture loaded yet. Trigger a capture from the extension popup.
preview_empty_state.description: Shown when preview page is opened directly without a job id

preview_not_found.message: This capture has expired or was closed. Take a new screenshot from the extension popup.
preview_not_found.description: Shown when jobId is missing from local IndexedDB cache

preview_loading.description: Shown while reading capture blobs from IndexedDB

preview_zoom_fit.description: Button to fit screenshot width inside viewport

preview_zoom_100.description: Button to view screenshot at 1:1 native pixels

preview_zoom_in.description: Accessible label for zoom in button

preview_zoom_out.description: Accessible label for zoom out button

preview_parts_badge.description: Badge showing number of chunks in an ultra-tall capture

preview_part_header.description: Caption above each chunk in multi-part preview

preview_downloading.description: Button state while encoding and downloading

preview_download_error.description: Feedback shown if encoding or download fails

overlay_hint_drag.description: Instruction pill shown on page during region selection

overlay_hint_esc.description: Short Escape hint next to dimensions badge

overlay_btn_cancel.description: Cancel button in region selection toolbar

cmd_capture_full.description: Keyboard command description for full-page capture

cmd_capture_region.message: Select and capture custom page region
cmd_capture_region.description: Keyboard command description for drag-to-select region capture

popup_switch_lang_label.message: Switch interface language between Arabic and English
popup_switch_lang_label.description: Accessible label for language switcher button
